meta.title: Microsoft Fake Sign-In Sites Catalog
meta.purpose: Defensive blocklist of LIVE URLs impersonating Microsoft sign-in pages (Microsoft 365, Outlook, Azure AD / Entra ID, Live) for blocking, detection engineering and threat hunting.
meta.warning: URLs are REAL and UNDEFANGED. Do not visit or submit credentials — consume them in blocklists and hunting queries only. Refreshed hourly; rolling retention window.

entries.technique: Compromised legitimate .cl site hosting a static HTML 'Access your file - OneDrive' document lure that pivots to a credential form
entries.detection: Hunt proxy logs for .html GETs under /centennialcws/ or any *-verify-obf.html filename on non-Microsoft hosts; alert on HTML page titles containing 'OneDrive' served from a non-microsoft.com/sharepoint.com origin
entries.source: phishunt.io (confirmed live, page title 'Access your file - OneDrive')

entries.detection: Alert on DNS/TLS SNI for registered domains that concatenate two Microsoft product strings (sharepointonline + microsoft) outside of *.microsoft.com; flag single-param query keys like ?normal= on first-seen domains

entries.technique: Homoglyph typosquat (microsofl ← microsoft) run as a subdomain on a multi-brand phishing-as-a-service host that also serves bank lures
entries.detection: Run Levenshtein distance <=1 against 'microsoft' over subdomain labels in DNS logs; pivot on the parent domain compras-ok.com — any subdomain under it is hostile

entries.technique: Free website-builder (Flazio) subdomain hosting an Outlook sign-in clone — abuses a trusted SaaS parent domain and valid wildcard TLS

entries.technique: Vercel-hosted static sign-in clone using a numeric-suffix throwaway project name for rapid redeployment
entries.detection: Hunt *.vercel.app hostnames matching ^microsoft[0-9]+ or ^outlook/onedrive + digits; Vercel/Netlify/Pages subdomains should never host Microsoft-branded auth forms

entries.technique: Vercel-hosted OneDrive document-share lure; same naming family as the previously tracked onedrive-4-nine.vercel.app

entries.technique: Lookalike apex domain (sa-onedrive.com) with per-target subdomain, suggesting Saudi/regional org-specific credential harvesting
entries.detection: Block the apex sa-onedrive.com and wildcard its subdomains; hunt newly registered domains containing 'onedrive' with a two-letter country prefix (sa-, uk-, ae-)

entries.technique: Spanish-language 'validate my account' Outlook lure on free yzz.me dynamic-DNS hosting; sibling of the tracked login-outlook365.yzz.me
